settings.body: Check KRYO, hose, Halo, power and refill reach before sticking the rail.

settings.definition: The ring-shaped shower head that mounts on the rail above you. It spreads cold water across the shoulders and upper body.
The control on the Halo that opens and closes water flow. Keep it closed until you are ready to start.
The vertical adhesive rail that fixes to the wall and carries the Halo.
The height-adjustable carrier that slides inside the rail and holds the Halo.
Carries water between KRYO and the Halo. A rubber seal sits inside each fitting.
The power supply that converts the UAE wall supply to 24V DC for KRYO. It must stay dry.
The opening on top of KRYO where you add water, and the plug that closes it.
The control on KRYO that starts and stops circulation to the Halo.

settings.title: Position & plan
settings.purpose: Decide where everything goes before mounting anything.
settings.quick:
• Place KRYO upright on a stable, level floor.
  • Keep the rear airflow area clear.
  • Confirm hose, power and refill reach.
  • Position the Halo above the user and keep spray directed away from the display and power side.
  • Do not remove the rail adhesive yet.
settings.critical: Do not stick the rail down until the complete layout has been checked.
settings.detail:
Halo height. The Halo should sit at least 30 cm above the tallest user’s head. Where space and hose length allow, 40 to 50 cm gives broader shoulder coverage — higher placement helps water spread across the tops of the shoulders and create a wider film over the upper body.

Check every component first. Lay out every item before you begin and do not install KRYO if anything is missing or damaged: KRYO, two-metre hose, Halo with flow adjuster, rubber seals, UAE PSU and plug, fill-opening plug, mounting rail, sliding connector, Phillips-head screwdriver. The rubber seals are small but essential — keep them with the hose fittings.

Airflow. Leave a clear gap behind KRYO so warm air can exit from the rear. Do not press the rear against a wall, towel or curtain — restricted airflow can reduce cooling performance and may cause overheating.

Reach checks. Connect the hose and Halo, hold the rail in the proposed position, then confirm: the hose reaches without pulling or kinking; the PSU reaches a suitable wall outlet; a bidet or shower hose can reach the fill opening; spray stays away from KRYO’s display and power side.

Spray direction. The display and power button are on KRYO’s right-hand side. Mount the Halo on the opposite side where possible.

settings.title: Mount the Halo
settings.purpose: Assemble the rail and mount it once the position is confirmed.
settings.quick:
• Insert the sliding connector into the rail.
  • Refit the rail end cap.
  • Make sure the slider moves correctly.
  • Clean and completely dry the wall.
  • Align the rail and press it firmly into position.
settings.critical: Adhesive is difficult to reposition. Confirm the location before applying it.
settings.detail:
Rail assembly. Remove one plastic end cap with the supplied screwdriver. Slide the height-adjustable connector into the rail, press the button and confirm it moves freely. Refit the end cap and tighten the screw without overtightening.

Final position test. Fit the Halo and hose to the slider, hold the complete rail against the wall and check once more: the rail is vertical; the Halo is high enough; the hose is not stretched and has no sharp kink; spray points away from the power side; rear airflow stays clear; the refill hose reaches KRYO; the power cable reaches safely. Mark the rail position with removable tape.

Surface preparation. The wall must be smooth, clean, dry and free from soap film, oil, dust or loose material. Use only the preparation method approved for your wall and the supplied adhesive.

Applying the rail. Remove the adhesive covers, align the rail with your marks, make first contact carefully, then press firmly across every adhesive point. Allow the approved setting time before loading the rail.
settings.alt_1: A hand wiping the tiled wall with a microfibre cloth so the surface is clean, dry and free of dust or oil
settings.alt_2: The rail being aligned and pressed firmly into position on the prepared wall

settings.title: Connect
settings.purpose: Connect the Halo, hose and power.
settings.quick:
• Check the rubber seal inside each water fitting.
  • Connect the hose to the Halo.
  • Connect the other end to KRYO.
  • Hand-tighten only.
  • Connect KRYO’s 24V DC lead to the supplied PSU, then connect the PSU to a suitable dry mains outlet.
settings.critical:
Seal flat. Fit squarely. Hand-tight only.

Keep the PSU and mains connection dry and away from standing water or splash.
settings.detail:
Seals. A rubber seal must sit flat inside each hose fitting. Correct: seal flat and centred. Incorrect: missing, twisted or pinched. A missing or misaligned seal can cause leaking.

Water connections. Hand-tighten one hose end onto the Halo and the other onto KRYO’s outlet. Check the hose follows a smooth path. Do not cross-thread or overtighten.

Both flow controls closed to start. Keep the Halo flow adjuster closed and KRYO’s water-flow control off until you are ready to prime.

Power. The PSU converts the UAE wall supply to 24V DC for KRYO. Keep KRYO switched off and dry your hands. Connect KRYO’s 24V DC lead to the PSU, place the PSU and its connection outside the splash zone, then connect the UAE plug to a suitable wall outlet. Route cables away from water and foot traffic.
settings.alt_1: Close-up of the lower rail connection where the hose screws on, showing the rubber seal seated flat
settings.alt_2: A hand attaching the hose to the KRYO outlet fitting, hand-tighten only

settings.title: Fill & start
settings.purpose: Prime KRYO, start circulation and fill it safely.
settings.quick:
• Open the fill plug.
  • Add water before powering the pump.
  • Switch KRYO on and confirm smooth circulation.
  • Continue filling slowly to the safe level.
  • Dry the top and refit the fill plug.
  • Start around 15°C.
settings.critical:
Never run the pump dry. If you hear a harsh dry-running sound or see no circulation, switch KRYO off immediately and add water.

Do not overfill. Never set KRYO below 1°C or allow the reservoir to freeze.
settings.detail:
Prime before power. The internal circulation system needs water before KRYO is switched on. Add clean water through the top opening until the system is primed. The exact minimum priming volume is pending confirmation and is not published here.

Switch on and listen. Switch KRYO on, confirm the internal light turns on, and listen for smooth internal circulation.

Filling. Keep the internal light on while filling so you can see the level clearly. Add clean water slowly and stop at the safe level shown. Never let water overflow into the upper internal area, and do not fill to the top of the opening. The exact maximum fill level is pending confirmation and is not published here.

Closing up. Wipe away spills, dry the top surface, insert the supplied fill-opening plug and confirm it sits correctly.

Temperature. Press SET and choose approximately 15°C for your first session. Lower the temperature gradually only after you know how your body responds.
settings.alt_1: Unscrewing the KRYO fill plug by hand to open the fill opening, no tools required
settings.alt_2: Adding water into the KRYO fill opening to prime the system before switching it on

settings.title: First session
settings.purpose: Start gently and learn the correct body position.
settings.quick:
• Begin around 15°C and with lower flow.
  • Start with your back to the Halo.
  • Let the first water hit the shoulders and upper back.
  • Once breathing is controlled, rotate gradually.
  • Keep the first exposure short and comfortable.
settings.detail:
Final check before you start. Rear airflow is clear; the rail is secure; the hose is not kinked; both seals are fitted; the PSU is dry and outside the splash zone; water is below the maximum level; the starting temperature is around 15°C.

Why position matters. The Halo balances coverage, flow and droplet size to create a film of cold water over the upper body. Positioning it above your head helps water spread across the shoulders and carry heat away from more skin. KRYO is a different experience from full-body immersion — a short, very cold session can still feel extremely powerful and produce a strong sense of alertness.

Begin gently. KRYO can feel more intense than expected. Use a warmer temperature, lower flow and a short exposure for your first session.

Body position. Stand with your back to the Halo. Let water land across the tops of your shoulders or upper back before slowly rotating. Breathe normally.

Controlling intensity. Lower flow — around 5 L/min — gives a gentler experience, cooling down and longer reservoir use. Higher flow — around 8 to 10 L/min — gives a more intense experience with larger droplets and stronger wind chill, and uses the reservoir much faster. Flow values remain configurable pending final production validation.

Staying in control. Stand with your back to the Halo, start the flow, breathe normally, let water spread across your shoulders, and rotate gradually only when comfortable. End immediately if you feel unwell.

After your session. Close the Halo flow adjuster, switch off the water flow and check the remaining water level. Top up when needed, wipe splash from the display and power side, check connections for drips and keep rear airflow clear.
settings.always_visible:
Chest pain or pressure · severe breathlessness · dizziness or faintness · confusion · loss of coordination · uncontrolled shivering · blue or unusually pale skin · racing or irregular heartbeat · panic or loss of breathing control.

Stop the flow, move to a safe warm environment, and seek urgent medical help for severe or persistent symptoms.
